newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close down at 21.50.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close down at 21.50.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interbank rates closed sharply lower at 21.50 percent on Monday with dealers saying there was abundant liquidity on the market.
Banks' excess cash pushed the rate down from Friday's close of 22.75 percent and below the National Bank of Hungary's one-week reverse repo rate of 22.75 percent, dealers said.
"There's heavy supply on the market. We have just passed the tax payments days," said Zsolt Kovari of ING Bank.
